scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
May the endless glory be with the Kingdom of Rune-Midgarts and its seven royal families!
scripts.translation: 愿无尽的荣耀伴随卢恩-米德加尔特王国及其七大王族！

scripts.text: Welcome to Gloria, the fortress in Siege Battle TE. We provide services in cooperation with Kafra and the major royal families of the kingdom.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到格洛丽亚，TE攻城战的堡垒。我们与卡普拉及王国各大王族合作提供服务。

scripts.text: Gloria?
About Siege Battle TE
About requirements for participation
Forget it.
[Guide Soldier]
It has been named in honor of the seven royal families and the kingdom.
scripts.translation: 这里以七大王族和王国之名命名。

scripts.text: The whole city closely resembles Valkyrie Realm, and here resides the aspirations of the royal family for everyone.
scripts.translation: 整座城市与女武神领域十分相似，这里承载着王族对所有人的期望。

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
In Kafragarten of Aldebaran, managed by Gloria and Kafra Service, we have special rules that are slightly different from the existing ones.
scripts.translation: 在由格洛丽亚与卡普拉服务公司共同管理的艾尔帕兰卡普拉花园，我们采用了一些与现行规则略有不同的特别规则。

scripts.text: We call it Siege Battle TE.
[Guide Soldier]
You should not have troubles understanding the new rules since it is simply about setting a limit on qualifications for participation.
scripts.translation: 新规则很好理解，主要是限制参与者的资格。

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
It is a new stage prepared by the royal family in order to let more people participate in siege battles.
scripts.translation: 这是王族准备的新舞台，目的是让更多人参与攻城战。

scripts.text: Different rules are applied, and sufficient supports are provided since its atmosphere is similar to that of a gymnasium.
scripts.translation: 这里采用不同的规则，并提供充足的支援，因为氛围类似体育馆。

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
^4d4dffTertiary job class and users with expanded levels are not allowed in Gloria and Kafragarten regions, where Siege Battle TE rules are applied.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff格洛丽亚与卡普拉花园地区适用TE攻城战规则，三转职业及扩展等级职业不得进入。^000000

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
Also, we lend a variety of battlegears that you use only in corresponding regions for free.
scripts.translation: 此外，我们免费借出各种战斗装备，但只能在对应地区使用。

scripts.text: This may be the biggest difference.
[Guide Soldier]
^4d4dffNovice, primary, and secondary job classes are allowed to participate as well as extra job class.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff初心者、一转和二转职业，以及扩展职业都可以参加。^000000

scripts.text: Of course, primary and secondary job classes are included as well.
scripts.translation: 当然，一转和二转职业也包括在内。

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
In other words, tertiary job class and jobs with expanded levels such as Kagerou and Oboro are not allowed.
scripts.translation: 换句话说，三转职业以及影狼、胧等扩展等级职业不能参加。

scripts.text: Also, their buff effects get eliminated here.
scripts.translation: 此外，这里的增益效果会被清除。

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
Other than that, it is not much different from the existing siege battles.
scripts.translation: 除此之外，与现有攻城战没有太大区别。

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
May the glory of the royal family and Odin's protection be with you!
scripts.translation: 愿王族的荣耀与奥丁的庇佑伴随你！

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
This warp gate here will let you go into Gloria region.
scripts.translation: 通过这里的传送门可以前往格洛丽亚地区。

scripts.text: Please keep in mind that you are supposed to travel through warps here.
scripts.translation: 请记住，你需要通过这里的传送点移动。

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
You are now at the fortress in Gloria.
scripts.translation: 你现在位于格洛丽亚堡垒。

scripts.text: If you wish to return to Valkyrie Realm, you can travel through warp.
scripts.translation: 想返回女武神领域的话，可以通过传送点前往。

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
Welcome to Gloria.

Job classes that are allowed to participate in siege battles at the fortresses in Kafragarten and Gloria regions are limited to ^4d4dffprimary and secondary job classes as well as those without expanded levels.^000000
scripts.translation: 允许参加格洛丽亚与卡普拉花园地区城堡攻城战的职业，仅限^4d4dff一转、二转职业以及没有扩展等级的职业。^000000

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
In Kafragarten and Gloria regions, you get separate missions.
scripts.translation: 在卡普拉花园和格洛丽亚地区，你可以接到独立任务。

scripts.text: Some of them are not related to Emperiums, so challenge yourself!
scripts.translation: 其中一些任务与霸邪之阵无关，尽管挑战吧！

scripts.text: [Guide Soldier]
The royal family and Kafra Service have prepared a variety of retal items for you.
scripts.translation: 王族和卡普拉服务公司为你准备了各种租赁物品。

scripts.text: Although the rental period is relatively short, it's all free. So, don't miss the chance!
scripts.translation: 虽然租用时间相对较短，但全部免费。千万别错过！

scripts.text: [Sorin]
Welcome to Kafra Service~ We always provide the best to our customers.
scripts.translation: 欢迎光临卡普拉服务公司～我们始终为顾客提供最好的服务。

scripts.text: Finally, Kafra Service has established its own fortress!
scripts.translation: 卡普拉服务公司终于也有自己的堡垒了！

scripts.text: What is Kafragarten?
What is Siege Battle TE?
Qualifications for participation
Forget it.
[Sorin]
This is a fortress provided by Kafra Service in cooperation with the royal family of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 这是卡普拉服务公司与卢恩-米德加尔特王族合作提供的堡垒。

scripts.text: It means 'Kafra's garden.'
scripts.translation: 这个名字的意思是“卡普拉的花园”。

scripts.text: [Sorin]
Although it looks very similar to Luina
scripts.translation: 虽然它看起来和卢伊纳很像

scripts.text: It should be fine since it's servicing different users.
scripts.translation: 但服务不同的对象应该没问题。

scripts.text: It's like a training stage, so to speak.
scripts.translation: 可以说，这里就像训练场。

scripts.text: [Sorin]
Kafragarten is built in the region of Luina, and in Valkyrie Realm, the royal family's Gloria is founded.
scripts.translation: 卡普拉花园建在卢伊纳地区，而女武神领域则建有王族的格洛丽亚。

scripts.text: Kafra Service hopes that you would gain valuable experience in this new fortress.
scripts.translation: 卡普拉服务公司希望你能在这座新堡垒积累宝贵经验。

scripts.text: [Sorin]
Siege Battle TE is ^4d4dffsiege battles designed for primary and secondary job classes only, ruling out tertiary job class.^000000
scripts.translation: TE攻城战是^4d4dff专为一转和二转职业设计的攻城战，不允许三转职业参加。^000000

scripts.text: [Sorin]
It's been newly established in an effort to allow more users to gain experience through siege battles.
scripts.translation: 这里是新设立的战场，目的是让更多冒险者通过攻城战积累经验。

scripts.text: [Sorin]
Moreover, for your convenience, we lend a variety of items that you can use only inside the corresponding fortress. So, take advantage of this opportunity.
scripts.translation: 此外，为方便各位，我们会借出各种只能在对应堡垒内使用的物品。请好好把握这次机会。

scripts.text: [Sorin]
As they say, 'action speaks louder than words.'
Now, go and see for yourself~
[Sorin]
Primary, secondary, and extra job classes without expanded levels as well as primary and secondary job classes are allowed to participate only.
scripts.translation: 只有一转、二转职业，以及没有扩展等级的扩展职业可以参加。

scripts.text: [Sorin]
In other words, tertiary job class and jobs with expanded levels such as Kagerou and Oboro are not allowed.
scripts.translation: 换句话说，三转职业以及影狼、胧等扩展等级职业不能参加。

scripts.text: [Sorin]
Kafra Service will do its utmost to bring joy to your life through Kafragarten.
scripts.translation: 卡普拉服务公司会竭尽全力，通过卡普拉花园为你的生活增添乐趣。

scripts.text: [Defolty]
Kafragarten is like a mirrored image of Luina, so its structure is exactly the same as that of Luina.
scripts.translation: 卡普拉花园就像卢伊纳的镜像，结构完全相同。

scripts.text: [Defolty]
You can travel by these warps here.
scripts.translation: 你可以通过这里的传送点移动。

scripts.text: You can travel to Kafragarten using warp.
scripts.translation: 使用传送点即可前往卡普拉花园。

scripts.text: You can travel to Luina using this warp here.
scripts.translation: 通过这里的传送点可以前往卢伊纳。

scripts.text: Make good use of it
Who took the castle that was named after me, W?
scripts.translation: 到底是谁占领了以我W之名命名的城堡？

scripts.text: Hehe doesn't it mean that I'm superior to Tailing?
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，这不就说明我比塔林更厉害吗？

scripts.text: [Tailing]
This is the region of Kafragarten.
scripts.translation: 这里是卡普拉花园地区。

scripts.text: In siege battles in the regions of Kafragarten and Gloria, only primary and secondary job classes as well as users without expanded levels are allowed to participate.
scripts.translation: 在卡普拉花园和格洛丽亚地区的攻城战中，只有一转、二转职业以及没有扩展等级的职业可以参加。

scripts.text: [Tailing]
In Kafragarten and Gloria regions, you get separate missions.
scripts.translation: 在卡普拉花园和格洛丽亚地区，你可以接到独立任务。

scripts.text: So you should pay close attention.
[Tailing]
Also, we have prepared a variety of battlegears, which are available anytime upon your request.
scripts.translation: 此外，我们还准备了各种战斗装备，只要你提出要求，随时都能领取。

scripts.text: [Tailing]
But obviously, they're only valid in the regions of Kafragarten and Gloria.
scripts.translation: 不过显然，这些装备只在卡普拉花园和格洛丽亚地区有效。

scripts.text: [Tailing]
Ah if you think I'm mad because my name is missing from Kafragarten and if my way of speaking is a little stiff because of that
scripts.translation: 啊，如果你觉得我因为卡普拉花园没有以我的名字命名而生气，而且因此说话有点生硬的话

scripts.text: [Tailing]
Oh my.
Is that really true?
No way. W is no better than me..hahaha.
scripts.translation: 怎么可能。W可没比我强到哪去...哈哈哈。
